title: Protocol and Colony
author: Beatrix Quintana
blurb: Paloma Galloway, the caretaker of Earth's abandoned seed vault, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
